source: 이번 에이전트 실행 / 사용자 전달 결과와 별개
command:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,zipfile
root=Path.cwd(); h=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
initial=json.loads((root/'logs/ade95_submission_initial_inventory.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
allowed={'docs/ADE-95-독립뷰어-사용검증.md'}
changed=[n for n,v in initial['files'].items() if not (root/n).is_file() or h(root/n)!=v]
assert set(changed)==allowed,changed
old=root/'submissions/인지동_ADE-95_독립뷰어_20261008.zip'
assert h(old)=='2c95cda0ffb753e869486d7d9fbc2372deda2f2d68667f35bbdcfa2cab0d947f'
with zipfile.ZipFile(old) as z:
    previous=z.read('injidong_ade95/docs/ADE-95-독립뷰어-사용검증.md').decode('utf-8')
current=(root/'docs/ADE-95-독립뷰어-사용검증.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert previous.split('처음 NumPy import는 DLL 로드 실패였다.')[1].split('최소 설치 목록은')[0]==current.split('처음 NumPy import는 DLL 로드 실패였다.')[1].split('최소 설치 목록은')[0]
assert 'GUI 명령을 사람이 직접 입력하고 조작하는 시연은 아직 미확인' not in current
assert '직접 회전·확대·버튼·방향키 조작 성공은 미확인' in current
for entry in json.loads((root/'logs/ade95_user_execution_evidence.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['saved_folders']:
    for name,v in entry['files_sha256'].items():
        assert h(root/entry['original']/name)==h(root/entry['package_copy']/name)==v
print(json.dumps({'status':'success','existing_files_checked':len(initial['files']),'only_modified_existing_file':changed,'other_existing_files_preserved':len(initial['files'])-len(changed),'old_zip_sha256':h(old),'source_output_copies_byte_identical':True,'numpy_repair_history_preserved':True,'viewer_and_packaging_code_unchanged':True,'full_tests_rerun':False},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
